data.title: Binance Lists BQX
data.body:
Fellow Binancians,

Binance will add BQX/BTC and BQX/ETH trading pairs on 2017/09/22, 10:00 AM (UTC).  You can start depositing BQX here.

To celebrate the launch, Binance and Bitquence have committed a total of 110,000 BQX to reward customers worldwide. The reward program will be made available as part of the listing of BQX on Binance, according to the following structure:

Top 200 BQX Deposits Leaderboard Reward Program

Bounty (200 spots) - 10% of deposit up to a maximum of 500 BQX Tokens per user for the top 200 users with the highest BQX net deposit* or BQX balance** whichever is higher.

Bonus Bounty (1 spot) - 10,000 BQX Tokens to the user with the highest BQX net deposit* or BQX balance** whichever is higher.

*BQX net deposit - total BQX deposits minus total BQX withdrawals at the end of the program period.
**BQX balance - Amount of BQX in user’s Binance account at the end of the program period.

Program Period:

Deposits begin 1 day prior to listing activation day and continues for 4 days for a total of 5 days (1 day prior to trading + 4 trading days).

Program ends  2017/09/26 10:00 AM (UTC).

Details:

  1. About Bitquence (BQX)
  2. Fees
  3. Rule

Risk warning: cryptocurrency investment is subject to high market risk. Please make your investments cautiously. Binance will make best efforts to choose high quality coins, but will not be responsible for your investment losses.

Thank you for your support!

Binance Team

2017/09/20
